svg.title: Settings changes have different completion rules
svg.desc: Ordinary tracked edits follow OK validation and saving or Cancel restoration. Live operations and direct storage actions have separate results that parent cancellation does not reliably undo.

g.text: Know which kind of action you are taking
Finishing a field, saving settings and operating the machine are different steps.
Restore tracked edits for this visit
Live values and accepted child actions
Direct Save, Export, Import and Reset
Parent Cancel is not a universal undo.
Stored data and machine state need
Concept diagram. Use the specific procedure for the selected setting or operation.
